    (LOG10(sp.scanresolmm * 1000.0) / LOG10(sp.pointdense::numeric)) * 5.0 AS sri,
    -- SCE = CoverPct * (1 + LapPct/100 * (1 - CoverPct/100))

  JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry

)
